content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Sovereign commerce infrastructure offers digital creators a comprehensive solution to sell digital products online without relying on restricted payment platforms. With options like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, creators can build and deploy their own digital storefronts. In contrast, traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal offer limited functionality and restrictive terms, often resulting in account freezes and withheld funds.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal often restrict access to creators from certain countries, citing security or regulatory concerns. However, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH offer a way for creators to bypass these restrictions and sell digital products to a global audience. By leveraging blockchain-based payment systems like NOWPayments, creators can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, without the need for KYC or buyer accounts.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions offer faster payment processing and lower fees compared to traditional payment platforms. With NOWPayments, creators can accept payments with a 0.5% fee, and automatic webhook fires the moment payment confirms on-chain. In contrast, traditional payment platforms often charge higher fees, and payment processing can take several days. Additionally, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH provide creators with full ownership and control over their customer data and payment processing, eliminating the risk of account freezes and withheld funds.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives digital creators full ownership and control over their digital storefronts, customer data, and payment processing.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of sovereign commerce infrastructure is that creators own and control their digital storefronts, customer data, and payment processing. With solutions like COREMERCH, creators can automate their digital product delivery, and offer instant downloads to customers. Additionally, creators can leverage free services like Cloudflare Workers, which processes 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, and Supabase, which provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage on the free tier, to build and deploy their digital storefronts.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of sovereign commerce infrastructure architecture depends on the creator's specific needs and situation. For creators who want a comprehensive solution, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. For creators who want a more tailored solution, COREMERCH offers customized deployment options, including the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack. Ultimately, the key is to choose an architecture that provides full ownership and control over digital storefronts, customer data, and payment processing.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

Sovereign commerce infrastructure means that digital creators have full ownership and control over their digital storefronts, customer data, and payment processing. This is achieved through the use of blockchain-based payment systems, automated delivery, and customizable storefronts. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can sell digital products online without relying on restricted payment platforms, and avoid the risk of account freezes and withheld funds.
Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal can restrict access to creators from certain countries and freeze accounts without notice.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators should start by choosing a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, they should select a backend logic solution like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. Then, they should set up a payment system like NOWPayments, and configure automated delivery and instant downloads. Finally, they should test and deploy their digital storefront, and start selling digital products to a global audience.
